transactions.counterparty: Seven separate, unrelated third-party investors: Dental Designs Clinic Pte. Ltd., Petite Smiles Pte. Ltd., PMWChia Pte. Ltd., Asia Healthcare Group Pte. Ltd., Redbridge Health Pte. Ltd., Platinum Capital 1903 Pte. Ltd., and Singapore Aobo Brilliance Pte. Ltd.
transactions.citation: p2095/fn8: '13 strata units or approximately 18,546 square feet of net lettable space in the Wisma Atria Property (Office) were divested for sales consideration of approximately S$41 million[8] in FY 2024/25'; footnote 8: 'The strata transactions amounted to approximately S$41 million, compared to the valuation of approximately S$32 million as at 30 June 2024 by CBRE Pte. Ltd. (using the income capitalisation method and discounted cash flow analysis)'; Note 13(13) p7388: 'A total of 13 strata units in Wisma Atria Property (Office) with carrying value of $31.9 million were divested during the current period'
transactions.notes: AGGREGATE DEAL per spec: one deal_id covers all 13 strata units, sold to 7 different unrelated third-party buyers, with only one combined aggregate sale figure disclosed (no per-unit breakdown) — every property row would repeat this same deal-level reference_value and gain_loss_pct if the units were listed individually; here recorded as a single aggregated row since no per-unit split exists anywhere in the AR. Aggregate sales consideration ~S$41m vs aggregate CBRE valuation ~S$32m as at 30 Jun 2024 => (41,000,000-32,000,000)/32,000,000 = +28.13% (pct_source=derived; AR states both figures as 'approximately', no percentage stated verbatim). Net proceeds S$40,898,000 (after directly attributable costs); disclosed gain on divestment S$9,044,000 against carrying value S$31.9m (=> +28.35% on a book_value basis — not used here per spec's preference, but consistent within ~0.2pp). Reduced Group's strata title interest in Wisma Atria from 74.23% (30 Jun 2024) to 68.81% (30 Jun 2025). No single completion date disclosed for the 13-unit aggregate (transacted across FY2024/25); completed_date left null.
